You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 8e827f29adac0c3345f3184458e1d8502a88622d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sam Umbach <samumbach@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Mar 2014 15:07:22 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] Use BuildChooserContext environment in InverseBuildChooser

Fixes an issue introduced by 4fc7f4447c990082e8322c42ebafd1f33a2e60aa.

When polling git for changes, context.getBuild() returns null, manifesting in an NPE from  InverseBuildChooser.getCandidateRevisions() when polling a git repo and using an Inverse branch choosing strategy.

This was fixed for DefaultBuildChooser in 68331baf78649becac426b9362534faff08cf618--BuildChooserContext now includes the appropriate environment, so there is no longer any need to call context.getBuild().getEnvironment() as demonstrated in [DefaultBuildChooser.java](https://github.com/jenkinsci/git-plugin/commit/68331baf78649becac426b9362534faff08cf618#diff-59b21aee0282fdafd62036844373a19cL190).
---
 src/main/java/hudson/plugins/git/util/InverseBuildChooser.java | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/main/java/hudson/plugins/git/util/InverseBuildChooser.java b/src/main/java/hudson/plugins/git/util/InverseBuildChooser.java
index 7b3f693a..a929dd90 100644
--- a/src/main/java/hudson/plugins/git/util/InverseBuildChooser.java
+++ b/src/main/java/hudson/plugins/git/util/InverseBuildChooser.java
@@ -42,7 +42,7 @@ public class InverseBuildChooser extends BuildChooser {
             String singleBranch, GitClient git, TaskListener listener,
             BuildData buildData, BuildChooserContext context) throws GitException, IOException, InterruptedException {
 
-        EnvVars env = context.getBuild().getEnvironment();
+        EnvVars env = context.getEnvironment();
         GitUtils utils = new GitUtils(listener, git);
         List<Revision> branchRevs = new ArrayList<Revision>(utils.getAllBranchRevisions());
         List<BranchSpec> specifiedBranches = gitSCM.getBranches();
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the `InverseBuildChooser` class attempting to retrieve the build environment using `context.getBuild().getEnvironment()`, which returned null when polling for changes in a Git repository. This resulted in a NullPointerException (NPE) because the `getBuild()` method of the `BuildChooserContext` was returning null, indicating that there was no valid build context available at that time. The fix involved changing the code to use `context.getEnvironment()`, which correctly retrieves the environment without relying on a non-existent build object.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the `InverseBuildChooser` class attempting to retrieve the build environment using `context.getBuild().getEnvironment()`, which returned null when polling for changes in a Git repository. This resulted in a NullPointerException (NPE) because the `getBuild()` method of the `BuildChooserContext` was returning null, indicating that there was no valid build context available at that time. The fix involved changing the code to use `context.getEnvironment()`, which correctly retrieves the environment without relying on a non-existent build object.
